checklist.text: Does the description avoid introducing elements or details not visually present in the outfit collage?
Does the description include the temperature in °C and a qualitative thermal feeling (e.g., cool, warm, hot) relevant to the outfit?
Does the description specify the overall style or theme of the outfit (e.g., beach chic, gothic, sporty)?
Does the description indicate the occasion or context for which the outfit is suitable (e.g., date, wedding, night out)?
Does the description mention the primary color scheme or key colors present in the outfit?
Does the description capture the mood or aesthetic tone (e.g., effortless, glamorous, sophisticated)?
Does the description use concise, query-style language appropriate for a search or request?
Does the description reference the main garment or item that defines the outfit (e.g., dress, bikini, vest)?
Does the description logically connect the visual elements into a coherent outfit narrative?
Is the description grammatically correct and fluent, with natural phrasing for a user query?
